papers.title: Dynamic Mechanism and Information Design in AI-Agent Environments: A General Analytical Framework
papers.titleZh: AI代理环境中的动态机制与信息设计：一个通用分析框架
papers.abstract: This paper develops a general framework for dynamic mechanism and information design with AI agents, encompassing optimal contracting and integrating evolving hidden information and hidden action with partial verification, technological authorization, and multi-agent interaction. It nests conventional dynamic screening, hidden-action contracting, and conditional dynamic information design, while allowing reporting, action, and information-use decisions to interact through a common continuation mechanism. We establish a dynamic revelation principle and a recursive characterization of implementability in which truthful reporting and post-report obedience are jointly determined through continuation incentives. In quasilinear optimal-contracting environments, dynamic envelope and integral-monotonicity methods yield a verification-adjusted dynamic virtual-surplus representation and identify three distinct margins: dynamic information rents, verification rents, and the implementation cost of hidden action. These margins generate a branched hierarchy separating conventional dynamic screening, hidden-action contracting, and their joint problem. We also study the joint design of monitoring, information use, and incentives: more informative monitoring capacity expands the designer's opportunity set, but full disclosure need not be optimal, and information use can itself alter hidden-action incentives. With multiple agents, correlated information, peer discipline, coupled incentives, joint feasibility, and continuation opportunities create additional strategic interactions. Although motivated by AI-agent environments, the framework applies more broadly to dynamic agency settings with similar economic features.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么传统动态机制设计不足以应对AI代理环境？因为AI代理不仅拥有随时间演化的私有信息（如能力、目标），还能在报告后自主选择隐藏动作，并通过行为影响未来授权与评估。现有模型通常割裂处理信息不对称与道德风险，而AI场景下二者交织，且存在单向验证（如能力可隐藏不可伪造）、技术授权控制等特征，导致标准结论失效。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了一个统一的动态模型，包含一个设计者与一个或多个AI代理。代理拥有复合私有类型（目标、执行能力、信念、信息能力），可进行受限报告（部分验证），并在接收额外私有信号后选择隐藏动作。机制通过推荐、授权、奖励和信息披露来影响代理的延续价值，形成跨期激励反馈。关键设定是‘延续机制’作为激励工具。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文建立了带部分验证的动态揭示原理，其中激励相容需同时保证诚实报告与事后服从。最优机制设计中识别出三个独立边际：动态信息租金、验证租金与隐藏行动实施成本。这形成了分支扭曲层级，表明隐藏信息与隐藏行动问题不能简单叠加，而需联合求解，从而修正了经典动态筛选与道德风险的分离结论。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用递归刻画方法，将动态激励相容分解为诚实性、服从性和承诺一致性三个条件，通过延续价值链接。在拟线性环境中运用动态包络与积分单调性方法，导出虚拟剩余表达式。对于信息设计部分，则结合Blackwell序与贝叶斯可置信性，分析监控容量与信息使用的分离与耦合。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型虽具一般性，但核心结果依赖于特定假设，如完全承诺、可测性及绝对连续性条件。机制的可实现性也面临挑战。然而，该框架极具阅读价值，它系统整合了AI对齐中的关键经济要素，为理解‘渐进放权’‘战略评估’‘基于未来的竞争’等现象提供了严谨分析工具，其分支结构与非分离性结论尤其值得深入研读。

papers.title: Epistemic Disturbance in the Graph Model for Conflict Resolution: State-Preserving Actions, Four-Valued Assessments, and the Distinction between Capability and Intention
papers.titleZh: 图模型冲突分析中的认知扰动：状态保持行动、四值评估与能力意图区分
papers.abstract: In the graph model for conflict resolution (GMCR), a decision maker (DM) either moves the conflict to another state or does nothing. The basic definitions leave inaction implicit, so every action that leaves the state unchanged is treated as doing nothing. Yet announcements, exercises, leaks and selective disclosures are neither moves nor inaction: they leave the state unchanged but change what other DMs believe about which moves are available and which moves others would want to make. We introduce such state-preserving actions by augmenting states with the DMs' epistemic states: a physical move changes the physical state, a state-preserving action changes only the epistemic state, and inaction is the absence of a transition. Actions generate evidence through observer-specific interpretation maps. Building on a four-valued extension of GMCR from the author's earlier work, which separates evidence for and against, we show that evidence for a move can only enable perceived moves and evidence against can only disable them, that two of the four reduction operators ignore one kind of evidence, and that contradictory assessments are absorbing under monotone accumulation. With the monotonicity of stability in move sets, this fixes the direction in which any action moves a DM's stability judgements and characterizes when actions can enable provocation or deterrence. Capability assessments affect all sanction-based stability concepts, and on the DM's own side also Nash stability, whereas intention assessments affect only sequential stability. Hedging between two candidate types weakly expands or shrinks an observer's sequentially stable set according to how it reads contradiction. In the 1995 DVD format negotiation, general metarationality cannot distinguish its phases, since the computer industry group could always sanction; sequential stability, which asks whether it would, can.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统图模型将不改变物理状态的行为统视为‘无作为’，无法刻画现实中诸如声明、军演、泄密等虽不移动状态却影响对手信念的策略行为。本文指出这一简化忽略了能力与意图信号的关键作用，导致难以分析威慑与挑衅等动态。问题核心在于：如何在保留图模型简洁性的前提下，区分‘不动’与‘看似不动但传递信息’的行动，并形式化其对稳定性的影响。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者扩展图模型，将状态拆分为物理状态与认知状态组合。决策者（DM）可通过物理移动改变状态，或通过状态保持行动仅更新他人认知。每个DM持有对他人选项可用性（能力）和偏好（意图）的四值评估（是/否/未知/矛盾），并通过解释映射将观察到的行动转化为信念更新。稳定性判断基于感知模型进行，还原算子将四值评估转为二元决策。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文建立了状态保持行动的形式化框架，证明能力评估影响所有制裁型稳定性（如GMR、SEQ），而意图评估仅影响序贯稳定性（SEQ）。特别发现：当观测者将矛盾证据视为可信时，模糊自身立场反而能增强威慑力。此外，不同还原算子决定了主体对证据的敏感方向，揭示了操纵稳定性的通道差异。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用四值逻辑（Belnap逻辑）表示带有冲突或缺失证据的信念，并利用其知识序与真值序分离的特性建模渐进式信息积累。通过分解扰动为‘支持性’与‘反对性’成分，结合可达集单调性分析，系统推导出各类扰动对稳定性集合的影响方向。技术核心在于将认知变化映射为感知模型变动，进而传导至均衡结果。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设证据只增不减，排除了撤回、纠错等情形，限制了对长期认知修正的刻画。结果依赖于特定还原算子结构，实际应用需谨慎选择。尽管如此，该框架极大增强了图模型表达现实战略互动的能力。最值得读的是其对‘非移动行动’的精细建模方式与四值逻辑的应用逻辑，为信息战、信号博弈提供了新工具。

papers.title: Optimal Multi-Item Auctions with I.I.D. Values
papers.titleZh: 独立同分布取值下的最优多物品拍卖
papers.abstract: We study revenue-maximizing multi-item auctions under dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC) and ex-post individual rationality. Buyers have additive valuations, and all item values are independent draws from a common finite distribution. For every two-point distribution and arbitrary numbers of buyers and items, we give an explicit deterministic mechanism that is optimal among all randomized mechanisms satisfying these requirements, together with a polynomial-time algorithm for computing the optimal expected revenue. For general finite-support distributions, computing the exact optimal revenue is $\#\mathrm P$-hard, both for a single buyer with an arbitrary number of items and for two items with an arbitrary number of buyers. For a single buyer, we also establish hardness of computing an optimal mechanism. Building on prior work, we also obtain exact and approximate algorithms under different parameter restrictions. Exact polynomial-time optimization is possible whenever any two of the buyer count, item count, and support size are fixed. When only the item count is fixed, a polynomial-time approximation scheme constructs a mechanism with expected revenue at least a $1-\varepsilon$ fraction of the optimum for every fixed $0<\varepsilon<1$. All these algorithms satisfy DSIC and ex-post individual rationality.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在买家具有加总估值且物品价值独立同分布时，难以设计出收入最优的多物品拍卖？传统单物品拍卖已由Myerson解决，但多物品情形下捆绑销售、随机化机制可能更优，且主导策略激励相容（DSIC）比贝叶斯激励相容更强，导致现有方法无法直接应用。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，明确在何种条件下可高效求解最优机制。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑n个买家和m个不可分物品，每个买家对物品的估值独立同分布于一个有限支撑分布，且具有加总效用。机制需满足主导策略激励相容（DSIC）和事后个体理性（IR）。卖家目标是最大化期望收入。关键难点在于买家的多维类型与跨买家供给约束耦合，使得机制设计需同时处理高维报告空间与全局可行性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文的核心发现是：对于任意两点分布，存在一个显式的确定性机制，在所有随机机制中达到最优收入，并可在多项式时间内计算。而对于一般有限支撑分布，精确计算最优收入是#P-难的。此外，当固定任两个参数（买家数、物品数、支撑大小）时，存在精确多项式时间算法；仅固定物品数时，存在多项式时间近似方案（PTAS）。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过双重方法建立收入上界：利用向下激励约束构造带权流，结合虚拟价值分析得出紧的收益上限。对于两点分布，通过‘独占高计数’排序与阈值规则设计机制，并证明其恰好达到该上界。复杂度分析则基于归约技术，将计数问题嵌入机制设计中，从而证明#P-难性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 主要局限在于对一般分布仅提供近似或固定参数下的精确解，且机制构造依赖特定对称性。然而，论文的价值在于首次完全刻画了i.i.d.两点分布下的最优多物品拍卖，并系统厘清了不同参数设置下的计算边界。最值得细读的是其机制构造逻辑、对称性压缩技巧及归约设计，对后续研究具有标杆意义。

papers.title: Information Divergence and Endogenous Evolution of Asymmetric Information
papers.titleZh: 信息分化与非对称信息的内生演化
papers.abstract: Standard theories trace information asymmetry to privately held information, heterogeneous signals, or costly information acquisition. We identify a distinct mechanism: otherwise identical rational agents observing a common Markov state at asynchronous times can hold different predictive distributions because their information differs in age. When the transition kernel separates information ages, independent Bernoulli observation arrivals make such divergence recur infinitely often almost surely, even with identical arrival probabilities. When agents instead choose costly updating intensities, independent update realizations can regenerate heterogeneous information ages among ex ante identical agents. In a stationary Gaussian AR(1) environment, the consequences depend on common staleness as well as the age gap: holding the gap fixed, older information raises individual uncertainty while reducing expected squared forecast disagreement and the value of certifying relative freshness. This generates stale consensus: low disagreement despite high uncertainty. With multiple ordered ages, costly certification supports partial-unraveling equilibria in which fresher types certify and sufficiently stale types pool. Under geometric information ages, more frequent updating weakly lowers the smallest and largest equilibrium disclosure cutoffs wherever positive-certification equilibria exist. The framework has implications for credit, insurance, financial markets, and multi-agent AI.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 标准理论认为非对称信息源于私人信息、异质信号或获取成本，但本文指出一个被忽视的机制：即使初始相同的理性主体因异步观察同一动态状态，也会因信息‘年龄’不同而产生预测差异。问题核心在于，信息何时及为何会自发分化，这种基于时间的不对称如何持续影响信念、决策与披露行为。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定多个理性代理观测同一个马尔可夫状态，但观察时机随机或由自身选择更新频率决定。每个代理的‘信息年龄’是上次观测距今的时间，结合最新状态值构成有效信息状态。预测分布由状态转移核决定，若该核能区分不同年龄，则异步观察即导致信息分化。更新可为外生伯努利过程或内生权衡成本与预测损失。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，在独立随机到达下，信息分化几乎必然无限次重现；当代理人选择更新强度时，最优行为仍会导致异质信息年龄。关键发现是‘陈旧共识’效应：固定年龄差距下，共同老化提升个体不确定性却降低预测分歧，且削弱认证新鲜性的动机。这解释了为何低分歧未必反映高信息质量。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造信息年龄的马尔可夫过程并利用其平稳分布，结合贝叶斯预测动态进行分析。核心技巧是将预测分布差异归结于年龄分离性条件，并用几何级数处理AR(1)过程下的方差累积。对于披露模型，采用阈值均衡分析，结合期望估值差与认证成本的比较来刻画部分揭示均衡。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型依赖精确观测与特定转移核，现实中信息可能不完全或更新非独立。结果虽具洞察力，但量化预测需具体参数。最值得读的是其简洁机制——仅凭时间错配即可内生非对称信息，以及‘陈旧共识’对解释金融预测、信用评估和AI系统一致性幻觉的价值。

papers.title: Delegate Pricing to Algorithms: When Slow and Steady Wins the Race
papers.titleZh: 将定价委托给算法：慢而稳为何赢得竞争
papers.abstract: We study the strategic design of learning algorithms in a canonical continuous-time pricing game. We introduce a meta-game in which firms select learning rates for a gradient dynamic, evaluating payoffs as the discounted sum of profits accrued along the entire learning path. We uncover a fundamental dichotomy driven by stage-game incentives: if the stage game exhibits strategic substitutability, firms unambiguously prefer the fastest possible algorithms to rapidly exploit a gradually adjusting opponent. Under strategic complementarity, however, an excessively fast algorithm accelerates the rival's competitive response, destroying transitional profit margins. Even though the competitive price is a strictly dominant action in the underlying stage game, we prove that firms optimally design sluggish algorithms, extracting surplus during a prolonged convergence to the competitive equilibrium.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着企业越来越多地将定价决策交给学习算法，传统研究关注长期均衡，却忽视了学习过程本身的策略设计。本文提出一个核心问题：当企业可以选择算法的学习速度时，怎样的学习率能最大化整个学习路径上的累积利润？这揭示了一个被忽略的战略维度——过渡期的利润攫取。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 两家企业在连续时间的伯特兰德寡头市场中竞争，各自委托算法进行定价。算法遵循梯度上升动态调整策略，企业则预先选择学习率（即调整速度）。阶段博弈为囚徒困境，唯一纳什均衡是低价竞争，但企业通过调节学习速率影响对手的学习轨迹，从而在收敛前获取超额收益。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现阶段博弈的战略性质决定最优学习策略：若存在战略替代性，企业总是偏好更快学习，导致无均衡；而在战略互补性下，过快学习会加速对手反应，破坏过渡期利润，因此双方会内生选择较慢的学习率，形成对称纳什均衡。这解释了为何算法市场可能出现持久的超竞争价格。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者构建了一个关于学习率选择的元博弈，并利用投影梯度动力学刻画策略演化路径。关键技术是分析学习率变化对对方学习轨迹的敏感性，结合变分方程与参数依赖性理论。通过研究无折扣极限下的超额支付函数，并借助一致收敛论证将其推广至一般折现情形。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型聚焦于特定形式的梯度学习与对称设定，可能限制对更复杂算法设计的适用性。但其价值在于首次从理论上揭示了‘算法减速’作为动态承诺机制的作用。最值得阅读的是其清晰的模型抽象、非直观的均衡结果及对算法共谋的新解释视角。

papers.title: FAITH: Feasibility-Aware Safety-Filtered RL for High-Dimensional Systems
papers.titleZh: FAITH: 面向高维系统的可行性感知安全过滤强化学习
papers.abstract: Safe reinforcement learning commonly places safety and task performance in the same policy objective, where they can introduce competing updates. Safety filters separate them at action execution, but classical designs require an analytic safety function and dynamics model, and standard minimal-intervention filters are myopic to long-horizon task return because they minimize only instantaneous action deviation. Hard projections are also undefined when no safe action exists. We present FAITH, a feasibility-aware, model-free framework that approximates the optimal state-action safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering with a feedforward network. The task policy optimizes the task return through the filtered dynamics, which recovers the feasible constrained problem without a competing safety term in the task-policy update. When no action satisfies the learned safety condition, the same filter approaches the action with minimum predicted peak harm. On a double integrator example and a Safety Gym environment, FAITH achieves the highest return among methods with no feasible-start violations and matches the lowest harm from infeasible starts. On a 29-DoF humanoid, it reaches a 99.95% safety rate while retaining 97% of the unfiltered return in Walking-Avoid, and obtains the highest measured safety rate in Push-Avoid by learning to sacrifice balancing and fall away from the protected region. The same policies are also demonstrated on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统安全强化学习常将安全与任务性能耦合在同一个策略目标中，导致更新方向冲突。安全滤波虽能分离两者，但依赖解析模型且仅关注即时动作修正，难以应对长视野任务。当无安全动作可行时，现有方法无法定义最小伤害行为。本文旨在解决高维系统中安全与性能的竞争问题，并统一处理可行为与不可行状态。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为连续控制任务，输入为状态（如机器人位姿、LiDAR观测），输出为动作。任务目标是最大化回报，同时避免进入危险区域。安全通过一个可学习的峰值伤害函数定义。模型采用离线学习的安全判别器与前馈过滤网络，在仿真环境中训练并部署于真实人形机器人，评估指标包括安全率、任务回报及不可行状态下的最小伤害表现。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出FAITH框架，首次实现无需显式动力学模型的可行性感知安全过滤。在双积分器、Safety Gym和29自由度人形机器人上，FAITH在可行起点中达到最高安全率与任务回报，在不可行起点下实现最低峰值伤害。尤其在Push-Avoid任务中，策略学会主动摔倒远离保护区域，展现出自主权衡能力。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: FAITH通过学习状态-动作安全值函数近似最优安全判据，并用备份策略提供低伤害目标动作。前馈过滤网络通过残差结构逼近最小干预修正，训练时联合优化动作保真度与安全约束。任务策略在经过滤后的动态中训练，使安全不作为竞争项出现在目标函数中，从而解耦优化过程，提升整体性能。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法缺乏形式化安全与最优性保证，受限于折扣设置、有限惩罚系数与学习误差。实验局限于平面保护区域，硬件演示为定性展示。尽管如此，其系统设计清晰展示了从仿真到现实的迁移路径。最值得阅读的是其统一处理可行为与不可行状态的机制设计与端到端部署实现。

papers.title: Residual Modeling Closes the Regression and Generative Policy Gap in Robot Learning
papers.titleZh: 残差建模弥合机器人学习中回归与生成策略的差距
papers.abstract: Learning from demonstration has enabled impressive robot behaviors. A common choice for policy learning is to use diffusion or flow matching (Flow-Policies), which often outperforms direct action regression trained with mean squared error (MSE-Policies). This gap is commonly attributed to multimodal demonstrations. We revisit this gap from the perspective of statistical modeling: how action-prediction residuals shape policy optimization. Our analysis of real-world robot demonstration data reveals substantial state-dependent variation in residual scales and heavier-than-Gaussian tails. While both MSE-Policies and Flow-Policies exhibit heavy-tailed action residuals, their training gradients behave differently: MSE allocates more gradient magnitude to observations with large action residuals, which hurts optimization. Motivated by these findings, we introduce heteroscedastic Student-t action regression (HT-Policies), which learns input-dependent residual scales and reduces the influence of heavy tails. HT-Policies predict action chunks with a single feed-forward pass and can reuse pretrained flow-matching-based policy networks as the backbone. Across four simulation benchmarks and real-robot evaluations, HT-Policies achieves success rates competitive with generative policy baselines, both when trained from scratch and from pretrained vision-language-action and world-action models, despite being faster in training and inference. Together, these findings shed light on the practical advantages of generative objectives in robot learning from demonstrations and offer an efficient direct-regression alternative for a range of architectures and tasks. Project page: https://the-labone.github.io/regression-policy-project/

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在机器人模仿学习中，基于扩散或流匹配的生成式策略通常优于直接回归动作的MSE方法，普遍认为原因是生成模型能处理多模态行为。但近期研究表明，即使不显式建模多模态，性能差距依然存在。本文质疑这一归因，指出真实演示数据的动作残差具有状态依赖性和重尾特性，而MSE假设固定方差高斯残差，导致梯度被异常大残差主导，影响优化效率。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究从视觉-语言-动作演示中学习策略的问题，输入为观测与任务指令，输出为动作序列块。采用多种骨干网络，在仿真（RoboCasa、Bridge等）和真实机器人任务上评估。对比MSE回归、流匹配、扩散及新提出的HT策略。评价指标为任务成功率，同时分析残差分布、梯度分配与训练效率，关注单次前向推理的可行性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出异方差Student-t回归（HT-Policies），显式建模输入相关的残差尺度与重尾分布。HT策略在多个仿真和真实任务上达到与生成式方法相当的成功率，且训练和推理更快。关键发现是残差建模本身而非多模态建模是性能提升主因，通过更均衡的梯度分配改善优化，为回归方法提供了高效替代方案。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: HT策略通过联合预测动作均值与输入相关的残差尺度，使用Student-t似然损失，自动降低大残差样本的梯度权重。其训练目标缓解了MSE对异常值的敏感性，类似生成模型在低噪声阶段的平滑梯度分配。该方法可复用生成模型的骨干，并支持从预训练VLA/WAM模型微调，仅需增加一个尺度预测头。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: HT策略无法显式表示多模态动作，适用于模态单一的任务。其优势依赖于残差结构假设，若实际残差不符合异方差重尾，效果可能受限。建议重点阅读第3节残差分析与第5.3节梯度分配实验，它们揭示了生成式方法优越性的新解释，并为回归模型设计提供了实用指导。

papers.title: MiniWAM: Learning Compact Future Targets for Efficient World-Action Modeling
papers.titleZh: MiniWAM: 学习紧凑未来目标以实现高效世界-动作建模
papers.abstract: World modeling has emerged as an effective co-training objective for robot policies, giving rise to World Action Models (WAMs) that jointly predict actions and future states. However, most WAMs predict future states in the native representation space of pretrained visual backbones, resulting in high-dimensional targets with substantial training cost. We introduce MiniWAM, which instead predicts compact future representations learned from privileged current-future transitions. To construct these targets, we propose Predictive Representations via Inverse Spatiotemporal Modeling (PRISM), which combines inverse-dynamics supervision with feature reconstruction to emphasize control-relevant transition information while preserving useful future-state information. With the learned PRISM encoder frozen, MiniWAM is trained to jointly predict the resulting targets and robot actions from current observations. With 65$\times$ fewer native future feature tokens, MiniWAM consistently outperforms native future-feature prediction with both DINOv3 and WAN2.1 VAE features, while achieving up to an 8$\times$ speedup in world-action training. At 0.25B parameters, MiniWAM is already competitive with substantially larger WAMs on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmarks. Representation analyses further show that PRISM contributes behavioral structure beyond feature reconstruction alone. These results demonstrate that effective world-action modeling does not require predicting native visual futures, and that compact predictive representations provide a strong and substantially more efficient target for policy learning. The project page is available at: https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有世界-动作模型（WAM）通过联合预测视觉未来状态和机器人动作来提升策略学习，但直接预测高维视觉特征导致训练成本极高。尽管已有工作尝试压缩或稀疏化表示，仍依赖原始视觉空间作为预测目标。本文指出问题核心在于：并非所有视觉细节都对控制有用，关键是如何学习一个紧凑且行为相关的未来表示，以降低计算开销而不牺牲性能。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型在当前观测下同时预测机器人动作和未来状态的紧凑表示。输入为当前帧图像与指令，输出为动作序列和由PRISM编码器生成的低维未来特征。训练分两阶段：先用特权信息学习紧凑表示，再冻结该表示用于策略共训练。评估基于LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0等机器人操作基准，衡量任务成功率与训练效率。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出MiniWAM框架与PRISM表示学习方法，首次将紧凑未来表示作为世界建模目标，显著优于直接预测原生特征的方法。仅0.25B参数即媲美数倍大的WAM，在多个基准上达到竞争性性能，同时训练速度最高提升8倍。结果表明，高效的策略学习无需高维视觉回放，控制相关动态可通过小规模模型有效捕捉。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: PRISM通过逆动力学监督与特征重建联合训练瓶颈编码器，使其既保留动作相关信息又维持未来状态可解码性。MiniWAM则利用此固定紧凑目标进行轻量级共预测。该设计分离了‘表示什么’与‘如何预测’两个问题，使世界模型分支专注于学习行为结构而非像素级还原，从而在大幅压缩65倍未来token的情况下仍提升性能。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: PRISM目前需针对特定设置单独训练表示编码器，缺乏跨任务通用性；且两阶段训练冻结编码器可能限制端到端优化潜力。读者应重点关注其问题重构思路——用控制导向的表示替代原生视觉预测——以及PRISM如何通过双目标塑造行为结构，这对高效具身智能研究具有启发意义。

papers.title: Instance-anchored interaction evidence: Grounding robot plans in human pointing and handling
papers.titleZh: 实例锚定的交互证据：基于人类指向与操作的机器人规划
papers.abstract: A robot that assists people must often act on what a person has shown rather than said: which of several identical cartons was pointed at, or which box was handled. The plan is executed from the final scene, whereas the evidence occurs earlier, possibly on objects that have since moved. We propose instance-anchored interaction evidence (IAE), which registers every object of the final scene to its public identifier, keeps each identity through the video by backward mask propagation, and describes every frame by the geometry between hands, forearms and these instances. An evidence network trained only from task outcomes scores the instances. For pointing tasks, a grammar-constrained dynamic program trained with a structured loss decodes object-destination programs; symbolic programs handle reference disambiguation and, without learning, episodic tasks. On 1,255 WatchAct benchmark requests, scored by symbolic execution, IAE reaches 64.2% plan success on implicit-intent tasks against 27.5% for a 32B vision-language model (strict success 49.7% against 15.4%), and 46.4% against 27.0% on restoration, reversal and imitation without task-specific training. Controls with the same perception overlays, the same 32 frames, forward tracking, or a relation model trained on the same labels do not explain the gain. Given IAE's evidence as text with its meaning explained, the same language model reaches 57.4%: most of the gain comes from the instance-anchored evidence, and the explicit programs add 6.8 points at a fraction of the cost. Pointing remains the hardest case, with 16.9% strict success. The code is available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/iae-watchact.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 机器人需从人类演示视频中理解隐含意图，如通过指向或操作来指定对象，而非依赖语言指令。现有视觉语言模型（VLM）难以准确关联早期交互与执行时的对象实例，尤其在存在多个外观相同物体时，常因注意力偏差或身份混淆导致规划失败。这暴露了当前方法在跨时间实例绑定和动作语义解析上的根本缺陷。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在WatchAct基准上评估系统性能，输入为第三人称演示视频、指令及最终场景布局，输出为机器人应执行的操作序列。模型需识别被指向或操作的对象及其目标位置，并生成符号化操作程序。评估采用官方计划成功率与严格成功率，通过符号执行判断结果，不涉及物理抓取。实验涵盖非语言提示、指代消解和情景记忆三类任务。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出实例锚定交互证据（IAE），将对象身份显式绑定至最终场景标识符，并通过反向掩码传播保持其一致性。结合手部几何关系与弱监督学习，IAE使隐含意图任务的计划成功率从27.5%提升至64.2%，显著超越32B级VLM。结果表明，显式实例管理与结构化解码比端到端模型更可靠，且多数增益来自证据本身而非语言模型。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法首先将最终场景对象注册至公共标识符，并反向追踪其在整个视频中的轨迹。每帧中手部与前臂相对于各实例的几何关系构成交互证据。一个仅基于任务结果训练的小型网络打分候选对象，再由语法约束的动态规划器将证据转化为对象-目的地程序。整个过程无需逐帧标注，实现了从弱监督到结构化输出的有效转化。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖精确的公共布局进行注册，对定位误差较敏感；二维几何特征难以区分深度方向相邻的目标；且规划评估限于符号模拟，未测试实际执行。尽管如此，论文清晰展示了显式实例管理的价值。最值得阅读的是其系统设计思路、对弱监督与程序解码的结合方式，以及对VLM局限性的实证分析。

papers.title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
papers.titleZh: UNITAS: 一种用于具身操作的原生3D世界动作模型
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce UNITAS, to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, UNITAS achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有世界动作模型多依赖图像序列预测未来视觉状态，但图像本质上是视角相关的二维投影，无法直接反映物理空间中的真实距离和运动关系。这导致模型在不同视角或机器人初始状态下泛化能力差，且难以精确建模动作与环境响应之间的物理耦合。本文旨在建立一个统一于度量三维空间的模型框架，使感知、动作与场景动态共享同一物理坐标系。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型输入包括任务指令、多视角图像及相机参数，输出为机器人末端执行器的动作轨迹和环境中物体点云的位移预测。训练使用混合仿真与真实机器人数据，在共享的3D坐标系下进行。评估涵盖仿真环境中的任务成功率、对观测与初始状态扰动的鲁棒性，以及真实世界任务表现，并通过动作条件下的场景流预测精度衡量其世界建模能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 本文提出了首个原生3D的世界动作模型UNITAS，实现了观察、动作与场景动态在统一度量空间中的联合建模。在LIBERO等基准上达到99.8%的成功率，显著优于现有视频基线。其在动作条件下的场景预测误差比PointWorld低49%，并在真实任务中展现强鲁棒性，验证了3D原生建模对具身操控的有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心创新在于动作流与场景流的3D轨迹表示：将手部与夹爪运动建模为3D点轨迹，场景响应则由条件化的点云位移描述。通过世界对齐的位置编码将视觉token锚定至3D空间，即使无深度输入也能估计物理位置。物理时间轨迹分词器将整条轨迹压缩为单个token，实现跨频率与长度的数据对齐，支持高效推理。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管性能优越，但模型依赖预定义查询点（如夹爪几何点），对未知形态的泛化能力受限。训练仍需大量带标注的3D轨迹数据，且场景流监督仅在仿真中可用。最值得阅读的是其将动作与环境响应统一为3D轨迹的思想，以及如何通过时空对齐机制实现跨形态、跨视角的具身策略建模，这对构建通用物理交互模型具有启发意义。
